description: This is a shell script used for monitoring system resources such as CPU and memory usage of specific agent processes, restarting agents if thresholds are exceeded, and logging statistics. It is part of the Advsec (Advanced Security) component within a larger software project, likely related to security management on network devices or systems.

methods.name: get_agent_pid_list
methods.description: Retrieves list of PIDs for agent processes specified in CUJO_AGENT.

methods.name: get_agent_cpu_time_spent
methods.description: Calculates total CPU time spent by agent processes.

methods.name: log_agent_cpu_statistics
methods.description: Logs CPU statistics for agent processes.

methods.name: log_agent_mem_statistics
methods.description: Logs memory usage statistics for agent processes and takes actions if thresholds are exceeded.

methods.name: advsec_restart_agent
methods.description: Function to restart the security agent (invoked within mem stats logging).

methods.name: advsec_wait_for_agent
methods.description: Function to wait until agent is available (invoked within mem stats logging).
